newsitem.title: USA: Western says still seeking appraisal rights.
newsitem.headline: Western says still seeking appraisal rights.

text.p: Western Resources Inc said it will continue to pursue litigation in Bermuda that seeks appraisal rights for its 27 percent stake in ADT Ltd, the company that agreed in March to be acquired by Tyco International for $5.8 billion.
Tyco's friendly deal topped Western's hostile ADT takeover attempt valued at $22.50 per share.
A spokeswoman for Western said, "We have not made a determination as to what our postion will be right now (regarding the ADT/Tyco deal)."

"We have filed litigation in Bermuda to give us the option to receive cash or stock (in the Tyco/ADT deal), as opposed to just stock," the spokeswoman told Reuters. "That still is being determined in the Bermuda court system, and we are continuing that course very vigourously.
Western's announcement came hours after Tyco claimed Western dropped its court challenge to the ADT/TYyco deal.
A Tyco spokesman was not immediately available to comment.
Western also said it postponed a June 17 shareholder meeeting to vote on the ADT transaction.
A new meeting will be announced at a later date.
